시편 121:1.content: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

시편 121:2.content: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

시편 121:3.content: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

시편 121:4.content: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

시편 121:5.content: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

시편 121:6.content: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

시편 121:7.content: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

시편 121:8.content: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.
